python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
root = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or '.'
branch = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', root, 'branch', '--show-current'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or '(detached)'
dirty = bool(subprocess.run(['git', '-C', root, 'status', '--short'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip())
state = 'dirty' if dirty else 'clean'
msg = f'当前分支: {branch}；工作区: {state}。开始新一轮任务前，请先确认最新成果已回到本地 main。'
print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': msg}, ensure_ascii=False))
PY
